intent.description: 这是一个可复用的 Agent Skill 工作流，用于创建、整理和优化口播 B-roll 与完整讲解片。它支持十套纸拼贴主题的空首帧+完成态尾帧组装动画，以及低多边形动画的单首帧图生视频；支持动态 4–15 秒单句、批量 B-roll 和 beat map 驱动的 45–60 秒讲解片。根据动作与关系复杂度判断时长，静帧按 Agent 图片能力、用户平台 CLI、小云雀、HyperFrames 动态路由，视频按 Agent 能力、平台 CLI、小云雀、手动包、HyperFrames 动态路由，旁白按 Agent 内置 TTS、即梦 CLI、其他语音平台动态路由。严格要求静帧经用户明确确认后才进入付费视频生成，图片修改只能重新文生图且禁止把旧图作为参考图。用户提到拼贴 B-roll、纸拼贴视频、半调拼贴动画、低多边形动画、单首帧图生视频、给口播配画面、动态判断视频时长、把选题视频化、整理工作流或优化 Skill 时使用。
intent.job_to_be_done: Turn spoken lines and selected topics into cost-aware, approval-gated paper-collage or low-poly B-roll.
target_users: users who need manual video-generation packages
inputs: spoken lines, scripts, topics, or beat maps
outputs: Gate 1 visual plan with dynamic duration
mode-matched video-generation task or manual package
exclusions: do not use old images as generation references when revising
do not claim HyperFrames is low-poly 3D generation
do not commit credentials or provider tokens

qiaomu_defaults.public_claim_policy: claim only what local validation, install proof, human review, or provider-backed evidence supports

should_trigger: 请用这个 Skill 把口播文稿整理成低多边形动画工作流。
帮我优化 P-Broll 这个 Agent Skill，把这段提示词做成纸拼贴 B-roll。
请创建一个 Skill 工作流，把完整选题整理成带审批门禁的短视频画面。
should_not_trigger: 帮我把这段中文翻译成英文。
推荐一部好看的低多边形动画电影。
帮我计算这条视频的文件大小。
near_neighbor: 只帮我写一条低多边形视频提示词。
帮我翻译下面这段 prompt。
只帮我剪辑一个已经生成的视频，不需要制作 Skill。

portability.canonical_format: Agent Skill package with SKILL.md, references, scripts, evals, and release metadata

trust.user_confirmation_gate: Gate 2 approval is required for the exact current still file
trust.image_revision_policy: text-to-image only; never use an old or derived image as reference
trust.provider_policy: inspect live provider capability and cost; do not invent CLI parameters

permissions.external_network: only through user-selected or Agent-integrated providers
permissions.paid_generation: requires explicit model, duration, and cost confirmation
permissions.credentials: never write API keys, cookies, tokens, or passwords to project files

degradation.no_image_provider: collage may use HyperFrames; low-poly waits for a generative image route or user-provided result

gates.gate1: visual metaphor, theme, frame_mode, action units, and dynamic duration
gates.gate2: generate and show the exact approved still; stop until explicit approval
gates.gate3: use first-last for collage or single-first for low-poly, confirm cost, generate, and run mode-aware QA

evidence_boundary.public_claim_policy: claim only what local validation, install proof, human review, or provider-backed evidence actually supports
